title: Helixtra
summary: Coordinating patient care, appointments and clinic operations in a multi-tenant platform.
overview: A clinic management platform bringing patient records, appointment scheduling, clinical encounters and billing into one product.
role: Built full-stack clinic workflows and role-scoped APIs. Designed per-clinic resource isolation and idempotent invoice and payment workflows, as described in the supplied CV.
engineering: Clinic-specific resources and scoped API permissions separate workflows and data. Idempotent invoice and payment operations address repeated requests without treating repetition as a new transaction.
validation: Engineering documentation covers role-scoped workflows, clinic resource boundaries and invoice/payment verification. The public link opens the marketing website.
caption: Genuine public marketing website capture. The site's clinic preview is illustrative.

title: Wear Instant
summary: Private image handling and reliable asynchronous processing for virtual garment try-on.
overview: A virtual try-on product for ecommerce stores, combining a public presentation, merchant administration and backend generation workflows.
role: Developed the backend, validated private image uploads, integrated Vertex AI and implemented idempotency, usage quotas, a transactional outbox and recovery logic, as described in the CV.
features: Private garment and shopper image handling
engineering: Idempotent requests, usage quotas and transactional outbox processing coordinate work across request and generation boundaries. Recovery logic handles failures rather than assuming every external generation succeeds.
validation: Concurrency and failure scenarios were tested using PostgreSQL and Miniflare. The product remains in development, with the paid launch and Shopify App Store publication pending.
caption: Genuine public marketing capture. Promotional imagery is not a captured shopper-generation result.

title: Ibrahim Awad
summary: An Arabic RTL clinic website with crawlable pages and capability-aware contact and booking surfaces.
overview: A distinct website for Dr. Ibrahim Awad's practice, preserving the supplied branding while introducing a structured, accessible frontend and deployment foundation.
role: Migrated the supplied page into React and TypeScript, with static prerendering, explicit routes and a capability-aware booking-provider boundary.
engineering: Prerendered pages are delivered through Workers Static Assets. The booking-provider integration remains inactive; the review site presents contact-only enquiries instead of invented availability.
validation: The public review is reachable with indexing disabled. A final custom domain and clinical content approval remain requirements for an indexable launch.
caption: Public Arabic RTL clinic review website.

title: Tapora
summary: A physical memory-card experience connected to personalized digital pages and ordering workflows.
overview: Tapora connects a memory-card product with digital-memory pages, product selection and ordering. Its public receiving experience is presented as a tap without an app.
challenge: Commerce and media behind a clear API boundary
engineering: The documented monorepo uses a React frontend, Spring Boot API and Supabase authentication/data boundary. Cloudinary handles media for digital-memory workflows.
validation: The project includes gateway, backend and browser-test workflows.
caption: Genuine public website capture. Private memory pages and messages are excluded.

title: Maysa Waheed
summary: A couture presentation supported by catalog, order-request and atelier management workflows.
overview: An editorial couture website and catalog for bridal and eveningwear, with administrative content tools, guest enquiries and consultation flows.
challenge: Preserving a brand while adding product workflows
engineering: The documented React and Cloudflare implementation adds catalog and administrative operations around the existing visual direction. Guest order requests are kept distinct from a direct-payment checkout.
validation: The public technical showcase documents the frontend, backend workflows and deployment.
caption: Public couture website and catalog presentation.

title: Supreme Sparkle
summary: An Egyptian beauty storefront with cash-on-delivery checkout and practical administrative workflows.
overview: A storefront combining catalog browsing, product presentation, checkout, order lookup and administration on Cloudflare.
role: Improved availability-based checkout validation and added month-scoped administrative order filtering using Cairo date boundaries.
features: Product image storage and catalog caching
challenge: Availability-based checkout and accurate order periods
engineering: Checkout eligibility follows the documented availability model. Month-based administrative filtering uses Cairo month boundaries and server-side retrieval to include the selected period's orders.
validation: Project verification covered checkout availability rules and order filtering across Cairo month boundaries.

title: BlitzChatbot
summary: Tenant-scoped WhatsApp messaging, real-time updates and validated third-party integration.
overview: A WhatsApp inbox and automation platform with Java backend APIs and a React interface for messaging workflows.
role: Built tenant-isolated messaging APIs, WebSocket updates and webhook validation, as described in the CV.
engineering: Tenant-scoped Java APIs keep messaging data within its organization. Validated webhooks handle external events, while WebSockets update the operational interface.
validation: Project documentation includes local and backend-migration validation workflows.
caption: AI-edited preview with fictional contacts and chat.

title: Arkedia
summary: A product catalog and operations platform with role-based storefront and administrative workflows.
overview: A pharmaceutical and wellness platform covering catalog, orders, payments, loyalty, reporting and administrative operations.
role: Engineered the Java/Spring Boot and React platform, role-based REST APIs and Docker/Nginx/PostgreSQL/Redis deployment, as described in the CV.
challenge: A coherent commerce and operations boundary
engineering: The Java platform combines role-based API access, relational persistence, Redis and containerized delivery with Docker and Nginx.
validation: The public storefront is available for inspection; private administration and operational records remain outside this case study.
caption: Public catalog and storefront presentation.

title: Cheque Printer
summary: Document layout, printing and searchable cheque history in Arabic and English.
overview: A JavaFX desktop tool for bilingual cheque preparation, preview, configurable layouts and local record management.
role: Built the bilingual JavaFX and SQLite application, including layout, preview and local history workflows.
engineering: Bank-template layout, Arabic text support and PDF generation connect a desktop interface with physical printed output. Local persistence supports searching and managing prior records.
validation: The public repository documents implementation, templates and desktop usage. Printing and financial documents require careful layout and data handling.

title: Artline
summary: Interactive panoramas and image-enhancement controls around a multimodal AI workflow.
overview: A React and Spring Boot image application exploring panorama creation, interactive viewing and adjustable image enhancement.
role: Implemented the multimodal application, OpenCV.js client-side stitching and interactive enhancement controls, as described in the CV.
challenge: A usable interface for image transformation
engineering: React enhancement controls connect to a Java service and Google Gemini integration. OpenCV.js performs client-side stitching, while the panorama viewer supports interactive inspection.
validation: The public repository includes implementation and sample media.

title: Quantitator
summary: Java services and Python optimization modules for constrained fashion pricing and production.
overview: An optimization system using genetic and ant-colony algorithms with simulation setup, progress and result presentation.
role: Built Java-to-Python backend integration through inter-process communication and PostgreSQL-backed service work using TDD with Mockito, as described in the CV.
engineering: Java services coordinate Python optimization work. Error handling addresses malformed outputs and script failures across the process boundary.
validation: Backend development used TDD and Mockito. The public repository includes simulation and result interfaces.

title: Secure Notes Organizer
summary: A C++/Qt notes application built for the Siemens DISW internship final project, with encrypted storage and client-server communication.
overview: A team project completed during the Siemens Digital Industries Software (DISW) internship, covering note creation, tags, search, authentication and client-server storage.
role: Contributed encrypted storage and socket communication, alongside memory and performance refactoring, as part of the Siemens DISW internship project team.
engineering: C++ and Qt provide the desktop interface; socket communication connects clients with storage. Note sharing is recorded as future work.
validation: The public repository includes GTest-related artifacts and documented desktop workflows.
caption: Notes editor · Original Qt application interface.
